invariant: orthonormalized column-space principal angles/projector distance; sign flips and degenerate rotations are invariant
metric_note: QR-orthonormalized bases are required because stored Q/K columns have Gram residuals up to 0.0278; raw U.T@V is not a valid projector metric here. The first audit file is retained but superseded.
pass_criterion: all comparisons finite; max principal angle < 1e-4 degree; max projector Frobenius delta < 1e-5
